headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 1, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Will Warren pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball. Spencer Jones led the Yankees' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In other news, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 in a closely contested game, while the Baltimore Orioles edged out the Philadelphia Phillies 6-4.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Ryan O'Hearn (Pittsburgh Pirates) who was placed on the 10-day injured list with a left quad strain. Luke Raley (Seattle Mariners) was also placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 31, 2026, with a left forearm strain. Other notable injuries include Mike Paredes (Minnesota Twins) who was transferred to the 60-day injured list with a left oblique strain.

The New York Yankees made a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates, acquiring C Omar Alfonzo and OF Luis Cruz in exchange for RHP Camilo Doval. The Milwaukee Brewers also made a trade with the Cleveland Guardians, acquiring C Bo Naylor and RHP Codi Heuer in exchange for CF Blake Perkins and RHP Craig Yoho.

top_news.title: **Yankees Shut Out Cubs 2-0**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Will Warren pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball, striking out 7 batters and allowing 4 hits. Spencer Jones led the Yankees' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past Pirates in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 in a closely contested game. Sal Stewart led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Fall to Orioles in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles edged out the Philadelphia Phillies 6-4, securing a crucial win. Pete Alonso led the Phillies' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Andrew Painter pitched 6 strong innings for the Phillies.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Blue Jays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays took down the St. Louis Cardinals 3-1, securing a crucial win. Luis Urías led the Cardinals' offense with a single, 2 RBI, and 1 AB.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the St. Louis Cardinals 5-1 in their latest matchup. Impact hitters for the Blue Jays included Vladimir Guerrero Jr. and George Springer, while Jordan Walker and Alec Burleson led the Cardinals' offense.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down White Sox in 1-0 Thriller**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a narrow 1-0 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Drew Rasmussen delivering a strong performance on the mound. Impact hitters for the Rays included Edgar Quero and Yandy Díaz, while Rasmussen's pitching stood out in the win.

top_news.title: **Pirates Place Ryan O'Hearn on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates right fielder Ryan O'Hearn has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left quad strain.

top_news.title: **Yankees Acquire OF Luis Cruz in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring outfielder Luis Cruz from the Pittsburgh Pirates. Cruz joins the Yankees in exchange for right-handed pitcher Camilo Doval.
